milestones.title: 2.9 — Map editor
milestones.description: Edit the pause map and minimap tiles inside RedForge, exported with the project.

milestones.title: 2.10 — Scenario points and AMVs
milestones.description: Edit the game's scenario points and ambient mask volumes.

milestones.title: 2.11 — Navmesh: geometry editing
milestones.description: Edit navmesh geometry by hand, in RedForge and in Blender, and its special links.

milestones.title: 2.12 — Vehicles: inspector and handling
milestones.description: Inspect game and custom vehicles, edit their handling and metadata.

milestones.title: 2.13 — Animations in Blender
milestones.description: Make ped animations in Blender and bake them into a ycd the game plays.
